title: Baby led weaning veggie muffin recipe
summary: . -1cup chopped broccoli -1/2cup mixed vegetables -4eggs -2TBSP Heavy cream or milk -garlic powder / onion powder -cheese
steps: In a bowl, mix 4 eggs, 2 tablespoons heavy cream or milk, a little bit of garlic powder and onion powder, and some cheese.
Mix it all up, then take a muffin pan, drizzle it with some avocado oil, add the vegetables in the egg mix, then bake it at 375 degrees for 20 minutes.
I served it for lunch with a chicken vegetable puree and some raspberries.
